runs.question: Is the Agricultural Water Infrastructure Program Stream 2 active?
runs.answer:
**Yes, it looks open right now, but GetGranted lists it as inactive.**

- **Official IAF page:** The [Agriculture Water Infrastructure Program page](https://iafbc.ca/agriculture-water-infrastructure-program/) says applications for Stream 2: Community Projects are open and close on October 29, 2026. The search result was dated about 3 days ago. The [Stream 2 page](https://iafbc.ca/agriculture-water-infrastructure-program/stream-2/) says it is reopening on October 1.
- **Funding:** Up to $21M for the stream, $2M maximum per project, 50% cost-share.
- **Who can apply:** The official eligibility list wasn't in my results. A third-party summary says it's aimed at community bodies such as irrigation districts, local governments, non-profits and Indigenous groups, not individual farms. Please check the IAF page before relying on that.
- **GetGranted:** The [Stream 2 card](https://app.getgranted.ai/grants/1425) is listed as inactive, with a deadline of 31/07/2023. The linked GG1 record is listed as active. GetGranted data was last refreshed today, Oct 5, 2026.

The IAF page and GetGranted differ: IAF shows an intake open until Oct 29, 2026, while GetGranted lists the 2023 deadline and inactive status. I only saw the IAF pages as search snippets. I didn't open them in full, so confirm the dates there before telling a client.

Would you like me to:
- Open the full IAF Stream 2 page to confirm eligibility and intake details?
- Check HubSpot for clients who could fit?
- Pull the Stream 3 and Stream 4 cards for comparison?

runs.question: Is the 2 Billion Trees Program still running?
runs.answer:
**No. The 2 Billion Trees Program is closed to new applicants.**

- **Official page:** NRCan says the Government of Canada will wind down the program, as announced in the Federal Fall Budget of 2025. Existing agreements will be honoured, but it is no longer accepting applications. The [All streams funding page](https://natural-resources.canada.ca/forests-forestry/2-billion-trees-program/2-billion-trees-program-funding-all-streams) also says the program is no longer accepting applications for funding. Only current recipients can still use the portal to report. Source: [2 Billion Trees Program – NRCan](https://natural-resources.canada.ca/forests-forestry/2-billion-trees-program).
- **GetGranted:** The card is listed as [archived](https://app.getgranted.ai/grants/1384). It was last refreshed from the platform this morning (Oct 5, 2026).
- **GG1:** GG1 still lists the grant as active, so GG1 and GetGranted disagree on its status. The official page says it is closed.
- **For clients:** NRCan suggests the Regional Coordination Centre may be able to identify organizations with active 2BT agreements that are open to partnerships. That is a partnership route, not a way to apply.
- **Related program:** GetGranted has a card for [Growing Canada's Community Canopies – Tree Planting](https://app.getgranted.ai/grants/1798) (FCM). It's listed as inactive, with a June 30, 2026 deadline. I haven't checked FCM's own page.

Would you like me to:
1. Check FCM's official page for Growing Canada's Community Canopies?
2. Search for other active tree-planting or forestry grants for a client?
3. Look up HubSpot leads or clients who were interested in 2BT?
